context_requirements: Constitutive or inducible NOS expression and active NO synthesis
An inflammatory or stress stimulus driving NOS induction
Presence of NO-sensitive signaling pathways that are tonically active
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Induction of a shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in NOS pathway target genes or NO-responsive genes that track with drug treatment

evidence.supports: iNOS inhibitor protects human osteoblast cells from AgNP-induced apoptosis, indicating NOS/NO can modulate cell death programs in human cells
iNOS inhibitor FK330 reduces inflammatory cytokine and chemokine programs and apoptosis in rat liver ischemia/reperfusion
iNOS inhibitor aminoguanidine reduces inflammation, demyelination and apoptosis in a viral model
NOS inhibitor protects against testicular apoptosis in rats, linking NO to apoptosis in vivo
